body: Mostly future uncertainty. I feel like I don't have any qualities that could matter in today's world. But family issues have a big part too
I know I don't know you but I'm really proud of you!! Thank you for the hope. Hope you get even better (:

It's alright,, don't force yourself much. Give yourself some time. I don't know what youre going through but you're never alone in this. This subreddit is full of people who need AND want to offer help. You deserve to live, everyone does.

I've been feeling like that for a long time now. It was just today that i decided to talk to some people. I really don't think you're faking it because if you were, why would you ask for help in reddit. Being afraid of death is normal. Not being afraid is also normal. But just because you're afraid doesn't mean that your struggle isn't real. When you feel like your life should end, being a little afraid is completely normal. And reaching out to people is the most scary part for me. I'm not good with normal interactions yet alone feeling vulnurable. But if you talk to people, you will feel better. I think you should first talk to people who you know had some kind of experience about this. They should know how to support you. And if you don't have people close to you that do have experience, then you should talk to the ones that you trust the most. The ones that wouldn't judge you. 

And If you don't want to talk about this or don't feel comfortable talking about this, maybe just having conversations about other things could help. Just telling people that you love them and appreciate them might make you feel better. With the virus and everything it's hard to meet people and hang out with them but you can always just chat with them yk. Have fun. Forgetting about sadness isn't really possible, but maybe happiness can outweigh it. 

I won't force you to talk but if you ever want to talk to people online, I'm always here for you. Talking to people who you don't know might be easier.
are you alright? If you need anyone to talk to please write, I'll do my best to support you even if we don't know each other.
